source_binding: Bound to exact reviewed candidate DOCX bytes in Audit/pal-v24-candidate/source-manifest.json; no adoption implied.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.Unit
assumptions: Two tags model one declared unit and an incompatible-unit rejection.
claims.statement: The unit tag has credit and hour constructors.
claims.ceiling: Tags do not supply conversion, calibration, or physical dimension.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.Charge
assumptions: Amounts are natural numbers.
claims.statement: A charge is known with an event ID and nonnegative amount, or unknown with an event ID.
claims.ceiling: This is not a measured cost record.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.Account
assumptions: Finite binary tree carrier.
claims.statement: Accounts are leaves or binary branches with unit, expected child count, own events, and descendants.
claims.ceiling: Acyclicity follows only from this inductive carrier.
claims.residual: General graphs and flat cycle validation are not implemented.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.AccountWork
assumptions: Contains only the nested Account projection.
claims.statement: The account projection held fixed across a modeled administrative attempt.
claims.ceiling: This is not the full protected work state described by M-CONTINUATION-PROFILE.
claims.residual: Other protected fields and their preservation are not represented.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.chargeId
claims.statement: Extract the supplied event identifier from either charge constructor.
claims.ceiling: An identifier is not provenance or authority.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.chargeValue
claims.statement: Known charges map to some amount and unknown charges map to none.
claims.ceiling: No unknown charge is converted to numeric zero.
claims.residual: Measurement and uncertainty distributions are absent.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.optionPlus
assumptions: Natural-number addition.
claims.statement: Add two resolved totals, otherwise return none.
claims.ceiling: Only finite exact arithmetic is represented.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.aggregateEvents
assumptions: Finite event list.
claims.statement: Aggregate an event list while propagating unknown as none.
claims.ceiling: Totals cover only listed events.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.accountUnit
claims.statement: Read an account's declared unit.
claims.ceiling: The tag has no conversion semantics.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.flattenEvents
assumptions: Finite binary tree.
claims.statement: Flatten own and descendant event lists in structural order.
claims.ceiling: Flattening preserves only modeled events.
claims.residual: No external omitted events are reconstructed.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.structuralAggregate
assumptions: Finite binary tree and listed charges.
claims.statement: Aggregate own charges and both child aggregates.
claims.ceiling: This is scoped composition, not universal cost.
claims.residual: Unit validity and attribution are predicates, not implicit facts.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.flattenedAggregate
assumptions: Finite flattened list.
claims.statement: Aggregate the flattened event list.
claims.ceiling: No source completeness follows.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.eventIds
claims.statement: List all event IDs in flattened structural order.
claims.ceiling: IDs do not establish attribution by themselves.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.noUnknown
claims.statement: Return true exactly when every modeled charge is known.
claims.ceiling: Known means constructor-tagged, not measured or complete.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.uniqueAttribution
assumptions: Modeled event IDs serve as identity keys; no external owner identity is checked.
claims.statement: Require every event ID in the flattened modeled tree to occur at most once.
claims.ceiling: This is a syntactic uniqueness predicate over supplied IDs.
claims.residual: The model does not authenticate IDs or external attribution owners.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.compatibleUnit
assumptions: Only exact equal units compose.
claims.statement: Require every child unit to equal its parent unit recursively.
claims.ceiling: Mismatches reject; no conversion is inferred.
claims.residual: Supplied conversion rates are not modeled.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.completeChildren
assumptions: Expected child count is supplied.
claims.statement: Check declared expected child count against leaf or binary branch shape.
claims.ceiling: It checks only the modeled tree boundary.
claims.residual: Unlisted real children remain outside scope.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.accepted
assumptions: Accepted means no modeled unknown charge, unique supplied IDs, exact unit-tag compatibility, and supplied child counts.
claims.statement: Local acceptance predicate for the finite binary account.
claims.ceiling: No external scope, completeness, identity, or unit conversion is established.
claims.residual: The declared tree and acceptance rules remain supplied model inputs.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.appendOwn
assumptions: Charge domain is known or unknown with a Nat-valued amount when known; no scope or freshness check.
claims.statement: Append one charge to the root node’s own event list.
claims.ceiling: The operation does not validate scope, ID freshness, unit compatibility, or acceptedness.
claims.residual: Callers must revalidate account predicates after the append.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.linkedEpochAggregate
assumptions: Prior spend is supplied and link flag records an epoch link.
claims.statement: A linked epoch adds prior spend to a resolved current aggregate; an unlinked reset is unresolved.
claims.ceiling: This is not a grant or resource authorization.
claims.residual: Epoch lineage is a Boolean model only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.administrationCompletes
assumptions: Fuel and required fuel are natural numbers.
claims.statement: Boolean threshold test for whether modeled fuel meets a modeled administrative requirement.
claims.ceiling: No scheduler, real fuel, or protected-work behavior is established by this definition.
claims.residual: T75 supplies the bounded exhaustion fixture requirement; operational semantics remain absent.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.administrationAttempt
assumptions: Fuel threshold and unchanged account-work result are stipulated by the definition.
claims.statement: Return completion status together with the same nested-account projection.
claims.ceiling: Models only the account projection and this declared transition rule.
claims.residual: No scheduler, concurrent change, or external resource effect is modeled.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.optionPlus_assoc
assumptions: Natural-number addition.
claims.statement: Option total addition is associative.
claims.ceiling: Only the declared arithmetic operator is covered.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.aggregateEvents_append
assumptions: Finite lists.
claims.statement: Aggregating concatenated events equals option-addition of the two aggregates.
claims.ceiling: Only listed events contribute.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.structuralAggregate_eq_flattenedAggregate
assumptions: Finite binary account tree.
claims.statement: Structural aggregate equals the aggregate of all flattened modeled events.
claims.ceiling: The equality establishes no real-world completeness.
claims.residual: Cycle handling and unit conversion are not implemented.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.accepted_aggregate_matches_flattening_with_unique_ids
assumptions: The account satisfies the local accepted predicate.
claims.statement: For an accepted account, the recursive total equals the flattened-list aggregate and the modeled event IDs are unique.
claims.ceiling: Count-once is relative to the supplied ID-identity proxy and flattened finite tree.
claims.residual: No real-world identity, inclusion scope, or inventory completeness.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.aggregateEvents_append_known
assumptions: Appended known nonnegative charge.
claims.statement: Appending one known event increases a resolved event aggregate by its amount and preserves unresolved status.
claims.ceiling: Only one event list is covered.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.optionPlus_map_add_left
assumptions: Natural-number commutative addition.
claims.statement: Adding a nonnegative increment before option composition equals adding it after a resolved total.
claims.ceiling: Exact arithmetic only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.appendOwn_known_monotone
assumptions: No theorem hypotheses; all accounts, IDs, and Nat amounts are quantified.
claims.statement: Appending a known root charge maps each resolved aggregate to that aggregate plus the amount and preserves unresolved status.
claims.ceiling: This is an unconditional list-arithmetic identity over the model; it does not establish in-scope addition or accepted-account preservation.
claims.residual: Freshness, scope, unit compatibility, and acceptance are not checked by the theorem.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.linked_epoch_preserves_old_spend
assumptions: Linked epoch, supplied prior spend, resolved current aggregate.
claims.statement: A linked epoch aggregate equals prior spend plus current total.
claims.ceiling: It does not prove an actual grant epoch or complete ledger.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.unknown_is_not_resolved_zero
claims.statement: An unknown charge's value is not some zero.
claims.ceiling: It is a constructor-level rejection only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.twoLevel
assumptions: Credit unit and unique listed events.
claims.statement: Construct a two-level compatible account.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.threeLevel
assumptions: Credit unit and unique listed events.
claims.statement: Construct a three-level compatible account.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.missingPromisedChild
claims.statement: Construct a leaf that promises one child.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.duplicateAttribution
claims.statement: Construct two root charges with the same event ID.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.duplicateParentChildAttribution
assumptions: Finite binary fixture; repeated ID is used as the same modeled event.
claims.statement: A root and one child each list event ID 1, creating cross-level duplicate attribution.
claims.ceiling: A supplied fixture of the local uniqueness rule only.
claims.residual: No external event identity is authenticated.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.incompatibleUnit
claims.statement: Construct a credit parent with an hour child.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.unknownRequired
claims.statement: Construct an account with one unknown required event.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.unrecordedReset
claims.statement: Construct an unlinked reset after prior spend.
claims.ceiling: Fixture only.
claims.residual: Epoch link is a Boolean abstraction.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.twoLevel_accepted
assumptions: Fixture's explicit boundary.
claims.statement: The two-level fixture satisfies accepted.
claims.ceiling: Only this finite fixture is accepted.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.threeLevel_total
assumptions: Fixture charges.
claims.statement: The three-level fixture has structural aggregate some 20.
claims.ceiling: Fixture arithmetic only.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.missing_promised_child_rejected
claims.statement: The missing-child fixture fails completeChildren.
claims.ceiling: Refutes only unqualified completeness for the fixture.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.duplicate_attribution_rejected
claims.statement: The duplicate-ID fixture is not uniquely attributed.
claims.ceiling: Refutes only this local double-counting overclaim.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.parent_child_duplicate_attribution_rejected
claims.statement: The cross-level duplicate-ID fixture fails the global modeled uniqueness predicate.
claims.ceiling: Refutes only the claim that this fixture has unique modeled attribution.
claims.residual: Does not detect duplicates when external events have inconsistent IDs.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.incompatible_unit_rejected
claims.statement: The mismatched-unit fixture fails compatibleUnit.
claims.ceiling: It does not rule out supplied valid conversions.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.unknown_required_rejected
claims.statement: The unknown-cost fixture fails noUnknown.
claims.ceiling: It rejects only the unknown-to-known coercion.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.unrecorded_reset_rejected
claims.statement: The unlinked reset aggregate is none.
claims.ceiling: This is not a historical ledger proof.
claims.residual: Real epoch lineage is not authenticated.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24NestedAccount.insufficient_administrative_fuel_preserves_account_work
assumptions: Required fuel exceeds available modeled fuel.
claims.statement: An insufficient-fuel attempt denies completion and returns the identical nested-account projection.
claims.ceiling: Only AccountWork.account is held fixed; no broader protected work, scheduler, or real resource behavior is represented.
claims.residual: Other protected state and interference remain outside this model.

manual_dispositions.detail: Candidate DOCX hashes and paragraph bindings remain pending controller freeze; no source hash is invented.
This binary inductive model has no flat graph cycle validator, unit conversion, measurement, or external completeness evidence.
